report_title: MySpace Calculator APK E2E QA Run

google_reference.note: The official Google Calculator package was not present in the emulator image. No third-party APK mirror was used. Functional assertions therefore use the documented arithmetic expectations; this is not a live side-by-side Google comparison.

results.title: Operator precedence
results.comment: Observed result matched the expected calculator value.

results.title: Chained calculations retain unrounded precision
results.comment: After 1 ÷ 3 =, the UI result was ['CALCULATOR', '0.3333333333']; multiplying by 3 did not return 1. This is consistent with the screen feeding its rounded display string back into the next expression.

results.title: Scientific-notation result can be used in the next expression
results.comment: Initial 10^15 display was ['CALCULATOR', '1e+15']; adding +1 left an unchanged exponent result or produced Error. This is consistent with exponent-formatted display text not being accepted as a numeric literal by the expression validator/parser.
